is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on wild pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae sensu lato (s.l.), specifically Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae sensu stricto (s.s.) (Page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions a L1014F (Vgsc L995F) frequency of 89% on page 3, but this is a characterization of the study site cited from a previous study (Ngufor et al. 2015) rather than new genotyping results from the current trial.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts or frequencies with associated sample sizes are provided for the mosquitoes collected in the 2017 trial. The 89% kdr frequency mentioned on page 3 lacks a sample size and is cited from previous work.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as larvae from breeding sites close to experimental huts in Cové, Southern Benin, and tested as adults (Page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting results from experimental hut trials and laboratory bioassays (Page 3).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Cové, Southern Benin (Page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The experimental hut trial was conducted between February and April of 2017 (Page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study uses routine collections from a well-established field station in Cové, Benin, but does not report new genotype data that could overlap with other marker databases.

supplement.evidence: The paper describes its methods and results fully in the main text and tables; no supplementary files containing genotype data are mentioned or required.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the efficacy of Olyset Plus and PermaNet 3.0 ITNs against pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.l. in experimental huts in Cové, Benin. While the paper characterizes the local population as having a high frequency (89%) of the L1014F (Vgsc L995F) mutation, this value is cited from a previous study (Ngufor et al. 2015). No new genotyping data or genotype-specific sample sizes are reported for the target markers.
exclusion_reasons: The study does not report new genotyping data for the target insecticide resistance markers. The L1014F frequency mentioned is a citation of previous work (Ngufor et al. 2015) and lacks an associated sample size for the current study population.
